Applying the policy in order:

- Flag check: T6 found no duplicates. No flag.
- Deny check: The label is legible (T1) and shows B0726Y, a recalled model (T2). Model passes. Date code 8/22 is outside the recalled range of 8/21 or earlier (T3, R:date_codes). That is a deny. Purchase is inside the window at a listed retailer (T4), so purchase does not change the result.

The date code rule is a deny trigger, and deny takes precedence over needs_info. The destruction photo (T5) is also questionable, but it only affects the needs_info path, which does not apply once a deny is triggered.

reasons.text: The date code on the label is 8/22, which is outside the recalled range of August 2021 (8/21) or earlier, so this unit is not part of the recall.
The label photo is legible and shows model B0726Y, which is a recalled model, so the model itself is confirmed.
No duplicate claims share a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account, so the claim is not flagged.
Purchase at Fred Meyer on 2023-10-31 is inside the sale window and at a listed retailer, so the purchase requirement is met; it does not override the date code denial.
